edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the from address in transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender for allowance deduction in transferFrom.
msg.sender becomes the owner in _approve via approve.
sender is set from _msgSender in deliver.
_tokenTransfer requires sender == owner while canTrade is false.
claimTokens is restricted to the owner.
Lock time is computed as block.timestamp + time.
block.timestamp is used as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is used as the liquidity deadline.
_transfer compares from and to against owner for maxTx gating.
lock stores the current owner into _previousOwner.
_tokenTransfer branches on _isExcluded of sender and recipient.
deliver requires sender is not excluded.
_tokenTransfer restricts transfers to owner while canTrade is false.
botscantrade gates bot wallet transfers in _tokenTransfer.
constructor uses _tTotal for initial reflection supply.
